summary: SUNYAB appears in this window solely as a contextual reference — as the owner/operator of the South Campus (a key terminal site and land use feature along the corridor) and the North Campus (a major development driver in Amherst). The document describes SUNYAB's plans to convert the South Campus to a Health Sciences Center and reduce parking, and notes the South Campus as a visual and land-use landmark, but SUNYAB itself expresses no position on the transit project within this window.
summary_quote: NFTA plans to continue discussions with SUNYAB officials about the possibility of converting an existing lot for transit patron use.

mentions.quote: The SUNYAB plans to cut the number of available parking spaces in accordance with the anticipated reduction in campus population.
